title: Doritos Original/Cheese 380g, Smiths Original/S&V 380g $4.25 ($3.82 S&S / [Prime] 2 for $7.22) + Delivery ($0 Prime) @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Doritos Original/Cheese 380g, Smiths Original/S&V 380g $4.25 ($3.82 S&S / [Prime] 2 for $7.22) + Delivery ($0 Prime) @ Amazon AU

[King Steuart] $1.00/100g is what we should be paying for potato chips. Don't let the politicians fool you into thinking potatoes are a luxury item.
[Wolfenstein98k] Ok
1) Why does no one sell them for that price?
2) When do you expect inflation will take a dollar to below 100g of potato chips?
[King Steuart] This deal is $1.02/100g
All I'm saying is we hold for this price
I bought 4 bags
[maskedmustelid] With the extra 5%, makes it 95c/100g. Seeing both 5% for 2+ and 5+ items for some reason, shame they don't stack.
[4foxache] You sound like a man who's eaten his fair share of potato chips
[King Steuart] There are worse things to put in your body
[MrZ] Pretty sure Doritos aren't potato chips.
[4ustralia] Thanks got the Smiths Originals s&s $3.82 limit of 6 per customer
[Thermal] Given the state of some packages that have arrived from Amazon in the past, I wouldn't be sure whether I would in reality be ordering chips or corn/potato crumbs for garnishing.
[hamza23] I always order 2 or more packs to ensure they are sent in a box. If you order a single pack they can put them in a padded satchel and then they get crushed.
